ambiguity.detail: Flash-forward line introduces a punishment out of sequence.

verdict.hook_line: You will scrub the floors you walked on as an impostor.
verdict.cliffhanger_line: Ten days is plenty of time.
verdict.viewer_takeaway: An aristocratic family battles religious authorities while a villainous woman plots their downfall in the background.
verdict.why_it_works: The cold open flash-forward instantly hooks the scroll, followed by high-tension standoffs and a scheming villain.
